svg.text: chicken-details. What the player sees when zoomed in, and in dialog close-ups. Head parts are split the way they should be split in the model (separate meshes / bones).
front: keyhole bridge, 2 rivets per side, lens
Own mesh + "glasses" bone: can slide down the beak or be pushed up.
Eyes: white, orange iris, big pupil, one glint. Only seen in close-ups,
dialog and big comic beats. Keep them a separate mesh behind the lens.
3 long primaries = 3 fingers. Each gets a bone, so
she can grip the shotgun stock, a corn cob, a gnome.
Secondaries fan down when flapping (flutter); fold
flat under the coverts at rest. Alula (thumb tuft)
sticks forward at the wrist. Coverts: 3 scallop rows.
Fold: hand bone rotates back ~170 deg along the body.
3 front toes with knuckle segments, 1 back toe.
Foot IK for walk on uneven ground; toes curl
around a perch or the shotgun when sitting.
